description_en: Lists the tags that are bound to a key or a secret
description_zh: 查询密钥或凭据的标签
kebab_example: aliyun kms list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type key --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the resource.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601478.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
资源所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601478.html查看当前阿里云账号的可用地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

If not all results are returned, the NextToken value is included in the response. By default, 200 rows are returned per page. To retrieve the next page, set this parameter to the NextToken value from the previous response
parameters.help_zh:
下一个查询开始的Token。
如果一次调用只返回了部分被查询到的结果条目数（默认每次返回200行数据），则会同步返回NextToken参数值。您可以再次调用该接口，设置上次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，以实现分页查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The type of resource whose tags you want to query. Valid value:

key

secret
parameters.help_zh:
要查询标签的资源类型。取值：

key：密钥

secret：凭据
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
A list of resource IDs for which you want to query tags. You can enter a maximum of 50 resource IDs.

Enter multiple resource IDs in the `["ResourceId. 1","ResourceId. 2",...]` format
parameters.help_zh:
要查询标签的资源ID列表，最多可以输入50个资源ID。

输入多个资源ID时，格式为`["ResourceId.1","ResourceId.2",...]`
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag. A tag consists of a key-value pair.

You can enter up to 20 tags. Enter multiple tags in the `[{"Key":"key1","Value":"value1"},{"Key":"key2","Value":"value2"},..]` format.

The key cannot start with aliyun or acs:
fields.help_zh:
标签键。每个标签由一个键值对（Key:Value）组成，包含标签键（Key）、标签值（Value）。

最多可以输入20个标签。输入多个标签时，格式为`[{"Key":"key1","Value":"value1"},{"Key":"key2","Value":"value2"},...]`。

标签键不能以aliyun和acs:开头
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag. A tag consists of a key-value pair.

You can enter up to 20 tags. Enter multiple tags in the `[{"Key":"key1","Value":"value1"},{"Key":"key2","Value":"value2"},..]` format
fields.help_zh:
标签值。每个标签由一个键值对（Key:Value）组成，包含标签键（Key）、标签值（Value）。

最多可以输入20个标签。输入多个标签时，格式为`[{"Key":"key1","Value":"value1"},{"Key":"key2","Value":"value2"},...]`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: A list of tags that you want to query. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的标签列表。N的取值范围1~20
parameters.name: tag

NextToken.description_en:
A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

If NextToken is empty ("NextToken": ""), no next page exists.

If NextToken is not empty, the next query is required, and the value is the token used to start the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
本次调用返回的Token，根据取值判断是否具备下一个查询开始的Token。

如果NextToken为空，即"NextToken": ""，表示没有下一个。

如果NextToken有值，则该值就是下一个查询开始的Token
NextToken.title_zh: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
